sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 trophy list report

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task to do for it. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, then the stranger strands, then the post-story cleanup — and expect roughly 200 hours in total. The only trophy that can be missed along the way is Positive Mental Attitude, so handle its Chapter 1 meditation early and keep a manual save from the start of every chapter.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, which introduces Jason and Lucia and sets up the story. It cannot be missed: just play through the opening until the mission-complete screen appears. This is the first story trophy most players will earn, and it unlocks free roam in the opening area.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 1 until the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, stop and meditate at Lucia's balcony spot — it is the one missable step in the whole list (see Positive Mental Attitude) and it disappears once the chapter ends. Make a manual save at the start of the chapter so you always have a way back.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish all of Chapter 2's missions. Chapter 2 is also where the Kingpin Bowling alley opens up, so while you are here, play a frame there for the Let's Go Bowling trophy instead of leaving it for later. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, as with every chapter.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. One thing in this chapter is time-sensitive: the Race Against Yago, marked with an hourglass icon, so do not leave it sitting while you wander off to side content — take it when it appears. Save manually at the chapter's start before you begin.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Near the end of this chapter the optional strand 'That's Where The Money Is' unlocks the bank vaults, which you need for Maximum Withdrawal, so take that strand when it appears and bring your partner along. Save manually at the start of the chapter and again before the final mission.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission to close the story. Make a manual save right before you start it — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so that save is your only way back to the pre-finale state. After the credits, free roam continues, and the 100% checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. Story mission trophies like this one cannot be missed as long as you keep playing the main path — there is no branching choice that locks them out. If you are hunting efficiently, do the side activities that sit near each mission while you are already in the area.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story mission, so it unlocks by playing the main path and cannot be missed. Heist missions tend to be long, so set aside an uninterrupted session and make a manual save before you start, in case you want to replay the approach later.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play as part of the story. Like the other mission trophies, it pops on completion and cannot be missed by any choice you make elsewhere. Play it when it appears rather than stacking up side content first, so the story stays in order.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. This is a straight story-mission trophy: follow the main path until the mission appears, finish it, and the trophy pops. No special preparation is needed, and nothing in the open world gates it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed. While you are at the airport for this mission, note the layout: you will come back here later for Catch Me If You Can, which needs a large passenger plane parked at a boarding bridge, gates E3 or E4.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a story mission and pops on completion, so there is nothing to prepare and nothing that can lock it out. Keep your manual chapter-start save habit going: one save per chapter start is the safety net for the whole list.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, which the game tracks under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — the checklist itself only appears after the story. The 100% requirements are bigger than the individual trophies: 300 stunts (the trophy asks for 250), 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles discovered, 8 bank vaults, 39 illegal operations, all 8 garage properties (about $160,000), gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, and wins at all 14 Top Fun drone race locations. Work through the cleanup in the roadmap's final stage and this gold pops with the platinum not far behind.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, long airtime and the other stunt types the game counts. Stunts rack up naturally while you drive around Leonida, but for the last stretch, chain them deliberately: use ramps and long straight roads, and keep an eye on the counter. Note that 100% completion needs 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 rather than stopping here.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity in the game at least once. The list counts nine activity types, and the trophy pops as soon as you have sampled the last one — you do not need to win or finish any of them. A quick way through it is to visit each activity's location in turn during free roam: races, shooting ranges, fishing, bowling, the arcade, meditation spots, drone races, and the rest. If one type is not counting, check the Activities list to see which you have not touched yet.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges. This is one of the longer grinds: learn each challenge's target pattern, use the weapon the challenge gives you, and replay a challenge as soon as you fall short of gold instead of moving on — the range lets you retry immediately. It also counts toward 100% completion, which needs the same 42 golds, so there is no way around practising them all.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own course, so the trick is learning the gates rather than raw speed: fly the course once slowly to memorise the turns, then race it for the win. A win at every location is also a 100% completion requirement, so this trophy and the A Long Road grind finish together.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race course counts once, so repeating a favourite does not help. Work through the race list across Leonida, switching vehicle classes as the race demands, and pick a fast, stable car for road courses. Races also feed the activity and challenge counts, so they pull double duty toward 100%.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head: you score by landing fish, and the challenge is won on total catch, not on one big fish. Keep your line steady, reel in smoothly when a fish bites, and do not rush — a lost fish costs more time than a slow, safe catch. Find Cal at a fishing spot and accept his challenge when it is offered.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one full arcade game at an arcade cabinet. Any cabinet counts and any game on it counts — pick the one you find easiest, play it through to its end screen, and the trophy pops. Arcades are scattered around Vice City, so this is a quick trophy to grab during a free-roam session.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final stranger mission. Stranger strands unlock as you meet their characters around Leonida; each strand is a short chain of missions, and this trophy pops when you complete the last one in Andy's chain. Strands stay available across chapters, so if Andy's marker is not showing yet, keep playing the story and check back.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final stranger mission. Work through Kenton's strand from its first mission to its last — the strand markers appear on the map as you progress. Like the other strand finales, it cannot be missed: the strand stays open until you finish it, even after the story ends.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final stranger mission. Follow Billy's strand through its missions in order; the last one pops this trophy. If you are clearing strands in bulk, finish one character's whole chain before starting the next, so you do not lose track of which finale is still open.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Each strand belongs to one character — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret are six of them — and a strand only counts when its final mission is done, which is also why each finale has its own trophy. Pick up every stranger marker you see, finish each chain before moving on, and the silver pops on the eighth finale.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final stranger mission. Randy's strand, like the others, is a chain of missions that ends with this trophy. Strands do not expire, so there is no rush — but do not leave all eight strands for the post-story cleanup, or the cleanup gets very long.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final stranger mission. Complete Tyrone's strand from start to finish; the finale pops this trophy. Strand missions often send you across the map, so use fast travel or a fast car between steps and keep the strand's thread in mind rather than mixing it with other open missions.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. MISSABLE — the one missable trophy in the game: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears once that chapter ends, so meditate there before you finish Chapter 1, and keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 as a backup. The other 17 spots stay available for the rest of the game, so sweep them up during free roam after the story. If the trophy does not pop after 18 spots, reload the Chapter 1 save and check the balcony first.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret as part of his stranger strand. Bret's missions point you at a specific animal — follow his instructions to its hunting ground, track it, and take the shot cleanly. It counts as one of the eight stranger strands for Strangers & Freaks, so finish Bret's chain to its finale as well.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida, and a set only counts when every card in it is found — the counter tracks sets, not single cards, so a half-finished set earns nothing. Sweep one region at a time and use the in-game collectible tracking to see which sets are still short a card; the last three cards of your third set are the ones that pop the silver.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. Each location counts once, so the work is coverage, not repetition: move through the map methodically, region by region, and WAiNK It at every spot the prompt appears. It pairs well with exploring for The Goodtime State, since both reward visiting everywhere.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small goals listed in the game's challenge menu — driving, shooting, exploration and activity feats — and most of them complete passively while you play. Check the challenge list during the cleanup, pick off the ones closest to done, and note that 100% completion needs 70 of 80, so keep pushing past 50.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. The partner must be with you when the heat breaks, so do this during a mission or free-roam stretch where your partner is present — not solo. To lose a 4-star level, break line of sight, get out of the search area, and stay hidden until the stars clear; a fast car and a quiet hiding spot beat a shootout.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time — if the heat drops between shops, the chain breaks and you start over. Plan a route of three close-together shops, rob each quickly, and keep moving between them instead of lingering. Your partner must be with you for all three robberies.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. A vehicle counts when you first get into it, so variety is everything: drive whatever you pass, from sedans to trucks to bikes, and check the vehicle log to see what is still missing. 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 vehicles, so treat this as the first milestone of a longer hunt, not the end of it.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Pick a fight with a group of enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and work through them fast while it lasts — spread-out enemies waste the window. A mission with a room full of enemies is the easiest setup; do not try it against one or two stragglers.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge at Vice City International Airport — gates E3 or E4 — and take off with it. Get into the plane, start it up, taxi to the runway and lift off; the trophy pops on the unscheduled departure. Expect airport security and police attention, so go in with a plan to reach the plane fast and leave faster.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — a Rhino — at the Mile Zero Air Station. The base is guarded, so approach with a fast vehicle, slip past the perimeter, climb into a parked Rhino and drive it out. Once you are inside the tank and moving, the trophy pops. Bring full health and be ready for soldiers to open fire on the way in.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point. Go in quiet: move slowly, stay out of the staff's line of sight, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If a clerk or guard spots you, the attempt fails — leave, let the heat die down, and try again. Night hours and a quiet approach help.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults unlock through the optional strand 'That's Where The Money Is', which appears near the end of Chapter 4 — take it when it shows up, because vaults are not available before then. Bring your partner: the vault robberies pair with Hot Together, and each escape counts only if you get away clean.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — intercept one, stop it, crack it open and grab the cash, then lose the wanted level that follows. A quick ambush on a quiet stretch of road works better than a chase through traffic; once the money is yours, break line of sight and hide until the heat clears.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida — all 52 named areas on the map. The counter ticks as you enter each area, so the work is coverage: drive the highways, cut through the small towns and the swamps, and check the map for blank patches. It pairs naturally with You WAiNKer! and Whip It Good, since all three reward going everywhere.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Illegal operations are marked on the map once you find them; each gang's operation counts once, so you need nine different gangs, not nine robberies of the same one. 100% completion needs 39 illegal operations in total, so keep robbing past this trophy — the first nine are just the start.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. This is a quiet moment trophy: head to a bar or vendor on the Ocean Beach front, buy the cocktail, and the trophy pops once the scene plays out. No combat, no timer — just take the trip to the beach during free roam.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle into a showroom, then smash your way back out through the glass in classic style. Pick a showroom with a big front window, drive in, then floor it straight back out through the glass — the trophy pops on the exit, not the entry. The exact showroom is not pinned down in the published lists, so any large vehicle showroom with a glass front is worth trying; if it does not pop, try another showroom.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — the Kingpin Bowling illegal operation, which opens in Chapter 2. Go to the alley, start a game, and follow through a full frame. Do it in Chapter 2 while you are already in the area for the story, rather than leaving it for the cleanup.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Get both Jason and Lucia to maximum Strength. Strength grows through the activities that build it — workouts, fighting and heavy lifting — so train both characters steadily rather than only one. The trophy pops once the second of the two hits max, so check each character's stat screen to see who is still short.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. The profile tracks the choices you make across the game — how you handle missions, strangers, robberies and encounters — and the counter climbs as you play. There is no single trick: just keep playing, take the active option instead of the passive one, and check the profile counter in the cleanup to see how close you are.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed at something on your second try — the description points to a second attempt paying off. The exact trigger is not pinned down in the published trophy lists, so treat this as one that pops naturally: if you fail a challenge, activity or stunt and then succeed at the same thing right after, that is the shape of it. Do not force it; it is likely to land on its own during normal play, and the guide will be updated here if a confirmed method is published.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description suggests a weird, unexplained event somewhere in Leonida. No confirmed method is published in the trophy lists yet, so the honest advice is to explore the odd corners of the map: remote spots, late-night locations and places other players flag as strange. This one is likely to pop while you are out exploring for the other trophies, and the guide will be updated here once a method is confirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock people over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a melee drive-by. Drive slowly past a group of pedestrians, swing a melee weapon from the vehicle, and knock them down. The published lists do not pin down an exact count or spot, so a busy sidewalk in Vice City is the practical place to try it; the trophy pops once the game registers the drive-by knockdowns.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; take them to a contact who launders them and the clean money counts toward the $250,000. It is a slow grind, so launder after every big job instead of letting bills pile up, and keep robbing vaults, trucks and shops to keep the supply coming.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every purchase counts — clothes, food, ammo, car parts — so this climbs on its own if you shop normally. In the cleanup, if you are short, spend deliberately on things you will use anyway, like ammo and vehicle upgrades, rather than throwing money away on one big purchase.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties around Leonida. Garages cost money — about $160,000 for all eight together with the rest of the 100% requirements — so save up during the story and buy them in the cleanup when cash is plentiful. Each garage also gives you storage, so they are worth owning beyond the trophy, and the last purchase pops it.
sources: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find a vehicle you like, open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone, and register it — repeat with nine more different vehicles. It pairs with Whip It Good, since every vehicle you discover is a candidate for registration, so register the interesting ones as you find them.
